name: metric-gym-os-video
description: "100 Squares" — Metric Gym OS launch film, built with Remotion. Standalone: not part of the Next.js app bundle.

scripts.studio: npm run prepare-assets && remotion studio src/index.ts
scripts.render: npm run prepare-assets && remotion render src/index.ts HundredSquares out/metric-100-squares-9x16.mp4
scripts.render:landscape: npm run prepare-assets && remotion render src/index.ts HundredSquaresLandscape out/metric-100-squares-16x9.mp4
scripts.render:muted: npm run prepare-assets && remotion render src/index.ts HundredSquares out/metric-100-squares-9x16-muted.mp4 --muted
scripts.still: npm run prepare-assets && remotion still src/index.ts HundredSquares
